subject: business-studies
title: Sustainability Calculations Adventure
welcome_lead: You'll quantify the cost and value of sustainable choices — recycling, packaging and carbon.
meta_desc: GCSE Business Studies — sustainability decisions, recycling cost-benefit and packaging trade-offs.
final_note: You can quantify the cost and benefit of sustainable choices in business.

concepts.def: Meeting today's needs without harming tomorrow
Reprocessing waste back into useful materials
Total CO2 emissions linked to activity
Certified firm meeting strict social/eco standards

walkthroughs.body_html:
Sustainability protects the planet and builds brand trust with eco-aware customers.

It can also cut costs over time — less waste, lower energy bills.

Solar panels cost £10,000 but save £2,000/year — payback in 5 years.

Reusable packaging costs more upfront but lowers waste fees and impresses customers.

B-corps are certified for high social and environmental standards.

This badge attracts ethical investors, premium customers and motivated staff.

mcqs.q: Which is a RENEWABLE energy source?
options: Coal
Natural gas
Wind
Oil

mcqs.q: Switching to biodegradable packaging mainly helps which area?
options: Labour turnover
Brand image and waste
Tax rate
Interest payments

mcqs.q: What is Herzberg's distinction between hygiene factors and motivators?
options: Higher pay always motivates employees.
Hygiene factors are about workplace cleanliness.
Ansoff's Matrix shows market share against profit.
Hygiene factors (pay, conditions, policies) prevent dissatisfaction when present but don't motivate; motivators (recognition, achievement, responsibility) create positive satisfaction.

mcqs.q: What four growth strategies does Ansoff's Matrix identify?
options: Market penetration (existing product, existing market), market development (existing product, new market), product development (new product, existing market), diversification (new product, new market).
Ansoff's Matrix shows market share against profit.
Hygiene factors are about workplace cleanliness.
Ansoff's Matrix is about analysing competitors.

mcqs.q: What are Porter's two main generic strategies for competitive advantage?
options: Porter says businesses should pursue both low cost and differentiation at once.
Cost leadership (being the lowest-cost producer) and differentiation (offering unique value customers will pay more for) — Porter argues firms should choose one or the other.
Ansoff's Matrix shows market share against profit.
Porter's strategies are about marketing channels.
